SELECT s.staff_id, s.role, s.full_name, s.is_active,
       COALESCE(sp.can_view, FALSE) AS can_view,
       COALESCE(sp.can_edit, FALSE) AS can_edit
FROM staff s
LEFT JOIN staff_permissions sp
  ON sp.staff_id = s.staff_id AND sp.class_name = $1
WHERE s.staff_id = $2;

SELECT student_id, student_code, first_name, last_name, class_name
FROM students
WHERE ($1::uuid IS NULL OR student_id = $1::uuid)
  AND class_name = $2
  AND is_currently_enrolled = TRUE;

SELECT attendance_id, student_id, date, status, class_name
FROM attendance
WHERE class_name = $1
  AND date >= $2 AND date <= $3
  AND ($4::uuid IS NULL OR student_id = $4::uuid)
ORDER BY student_id, date ASC;

SELECT leave_id, student_id, leave_type, start_date, end_date, is_approved, documentation_ref, notes
FROM leave_records
WHERE is_approved = TRUE
  AND start_date <= $2 AND end_date >= $1;
